maya: Quick sync  planning a focused webinar + benchmark workshop next Tue to finalize launch messaging and inbound routing. Need playbook so SDRs can quickly tag demo vs technical interest. Agenda: 20m bench narrative, 20m claim pruning, 20m routing + SDR scripts. Who's in?

jon: I can own routing and SLA mapping. Recommend two paths: demo -> AE list, deep -> SE rotation. Keep it simple.

eli: Two paths good. For bench framing use 'serving-first economics' vs generic cloud endpoints. Keep claims conservative.

sara: I'll draft invite copy and two CTAs: "Request demo" and "Book technical deep-dive". Also will A/B three subject lines.

alex: SDRs want 1-line scripts. Demo: "Thanks for registering  want a 15m demo showing predictable latency?" Deep: "We ran long-context benchmarks  want a technical deep-dive with infra leads?"

maya: Ops-bot: please create Calendly and rehearsal event.

ops-bot: Calendly created: https://calendly.com/redwood/webinar-bench. Rehearsal Mon 11am PT.

maya: Action items: jon  routing webhook + example mapping; alex  SDR scripts; sara  invite + subject tests; eli  validate soundbites; maya  run claim pruning. Drop any slide one-liners by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
